info.title: RealMock API
info.description: RealMock mock-interview platform composition root (profile / resume / settings / prep / interview / records / growth)

get.description: Read the sole profile row (get-or-create).

put.description: Full PUT update of the sole profile row.

post.description: Blank every update-contract field; keep the row id. PUT cannot do this (required fields).
Upload a resume file as a new family (v1).

get.description: Return static upload / analyze / dimension limits for the frontend catalog.
List all resume rows, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Resumes Api V1 Resume List Get

delete.description: Wipe deep-review JSON + scores for all resumes; files and rows stay.

get.description: Download one resume's deep-review analysis; optionally fold in the resume.

delete.description: Delete every resume row and its files; review history goes with the rows.

get.description: Get one resume row.

delete.description: Delete the resume and local files if they exist.

get.description: Return the original file: inline preview by default, attachment when ``download=1``.
Paged preview meta; only PDF is page-rendered, other formats return pages=0.
Return a server-rendered PNG of the requested page (1-based).

post.description: Append a file as a new version of an existing family.
Mark one resume row active (deactivates the rest).
SSE: plan / tool_step / thinking / notice / done{analysis} / error.
Analyze one resume with the LLM and return the stored analysis.

get.description: Three-stage supplier capability catalog.
Read three-stage configs.

post.description: Three-stage connectivity test: recognize | reason | speak.

get.description: Flat model list for scene selector (enabled entries only, with ability bits and context windows).

Recommended (adapted) vendors tree: level 1 vendor, level 2 model type.

Drives the settings-page "add provider" panel; entries carry catalog prefills
plus the deep request template metadata when a vendor descriptor JSON exists.

post.description:
One-click provisioning: provider shell + one channel and default entry per adapted
capability; Base URLs and names prefill from the vendor catalog, API Keys stay empty.

delete.description:
Delete the provider and everything under it: model entries, channel settings,
and task bindings pointing at its entries (the UI asks for confirmation first).

get.description:
Model ids offered for this channel: vendor descriptor list or the provider's
OpenAI-compatible /models endpoint.

post.description: Selects test pipelines based on capabilities declared by model entries; does not change current task bindings.

get.description: GitHub link status: configured flag plus tail mask, never the secret.

post.description: Validate, encrypt, and store the GitHub personal access token.

delete.description: Delete the stored GitHub token (process-env fallback still applies).

post.description:
Probe ``GET /rate_limit`` with the candidate, stored, or env token.

Accepts an unsaved candidate so Test works before saving; never echoes tokens.

Wipe every user-content store: sessions, resumes, profile, uploads, growth.

Deliberately destructive and deliberately unscoped: the settings page gates
this behind a two-step dialog (typed acknowledgement checkbox), so the
endpoint itself stays parameter-free.

get.description: Return dropdown summaries only; exclude analysis text.

schema.title: Response List Resume Picker Api V1 Prep Resumes Get

get.description: List coaching sessions (shown in the frontend's “Conversation History,” grouped by resume).

schema.title: Response List Prep Sessions Api V1 Prep Sessions Get

post.description: Create an active coaching session and seed its capability cookie.
Run one synchronous coaching turn.
Stream one coaching turn as server-sent events (tokens + status/thinking/tool/usage/done).

get.description: Return sanitized message history for display (store is never mutated).

schema.title: Response Get Prep Messages Api V1 Prep Sessions  Session Id  Messages Get

get.description: Measured context breakdown of persisted history plus provider usage totals.

post.description: AI follow-up suggestions for the quick-prompts card (best-effort).
Run turn-start compaction now (the ``/compact`` slash command).

patch.description: Replace the current compaction summary text (user-edited correction).

post.description: Branch a new active session copying history through ``up_to`` (inclusive).
Retract a user message: drop backend history from ``from_index`` on.

delete.description: Delete a session and its history permanently.

post.description: Delete sessions that never accumulated user/assistant content.
Delete ALL coaching sessions permanently, with or without content.

patch.description: Archive (or restore) a session; archived sessions stay fully usable.

put.description: Link another session's summary + recent turns into this session's context.

post.description: Mint a fresh capability token for a listed session (owner-level recovery).
Record a long-term memory from the rating flow (or an agent note).

get.description: List memory index entries, newest first (clamped server-side to 1..50).

schema.title: Response List Memory Summaries Api V1 Prep Memories Get

get.description: List distinct memory tags, most-recently-used first.

post.description: Delete up to 100 memories in one request (CSRF-protected, rate-limited).

get.description: Load one memory with its full turn bodies.
Configure the resume summary for drop-down on the page; do not return the analysis text and in-depth evaluation.

schema.title: Response List Resume Picker Api V1 Interview Resumes Get

get.description: List multi-round processes (newest first) with next-round eligibility.

schema.title: Response List Process Routes Api V1 Interview Processes Get

post.description: Start a multi-round process together with its round-1 session.

get.description: One process with its round lineage.

post.description: Create the next round session after a passed round.

get.description: History list: Only metadata is returned, excluding access_token (anti-enumeration theft capability token).

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Interview Sessions Get

post.description:
Create a PENDING session, issue its capability token, and plan the flow.

The flow planner runs in the background; the opening turn waits for it
(bounded) and degrades to the static workflow on failure. The token is
issued via HttpOnly cookie only, never in the response body.

get.description: Fetch one session view; 404 when missing, 403 on token mismatch.

Return the session transcript as validated chat messages.

Dirty historical rows validate to an empty list rather than leaking
internal errors to the client.

post.description:
Run the opening turn over SSE-less HTTP (text-fallback path).

Only PENDING/ACTIVE sessions; requires a configured chat model.

Run one candidate turn over HTTP (text-fallback path).

Rejects finished sessions; finish-lifecycle side effects run inside the
runner, never doubled here.
End interview early: freeze ledger and notify (report is async via records).

Agent-researched brief (style / focus areas / process) for the setup preview.

Cached per company + role + level + interview type + language; generation
runs inline (bounded web research) only on a cache miss, so the request can
take tens of seconds when cold.

delete.description: Clear the whole question-style brief cache (settings-page action).

get.description: Setup-page dropdown payload (workflows / personalities / voices / avatars).
List interview sessions (metadata only) via the session catalog port.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Records Sessions Get

get.description: Return the frozen (or prefix) ledger for replay UI.
Return ready; A2004 while pending/generating/absent, A2005 when failed; A2001/A2003 via finished-session guard; legacy fallback if needed.

post.description: Re-queue debrief when failed/pending (idempotent). Ready rows are returned as-is.

get.description: Pseudo-stream a ready report; generate once if still pending.
Download the debrief report for one session (finished sessions only).
Download the plain interviewer/candidate transcript for one session.

schema.title: Response Get Growth History Api V1 Growth History Get

get.description: System-level self-growth insights (cross-interview aggregates).
Aggregated growth stats computed on request (frontend can drop ``computeGrowthStats``).
Latest LLM growth analysis (``insight: null`` until the first regen).

post.description: Schedule a background regeneration; returns immediately (single-flight).

BindingsResponse.title: BindingsResponse
BindingsResponse.description: Task → default handler map (keys fixed by ``STAGE_BY_TASK``).

parse_degraded.title: Parse Degraded
parse_degraded.description: True when structured parse fell back to a raw-text summary (LLM failure or missing API key).

ChannelModelCatalogResponse.title: ChannelModelCatalogResponse
ChannelModelCatalogResponse.description: Model ids offered for one channel (vendor descriptor or /models endpoint).

CompanyBriefResponse.title: CompanyBriefResponse
CompanyBriefResponse.description: Agent-researched question-style brief (cached or freshly generated).

DataClearResponse.title: DataClearResponse
DataClearResponse.description: Per-area row counts removed by the wipe-all endpoint.

DataExportFile.title: DataExportFile
DataExportFile.description: A single exported file, ready to be saved by the client.

GithubStatusResponse.title: GithubStatusResponse
GithubStatusResponse.description: Link status: configured flag plus tail mask, never the secret.

GithubTestResponse.title: GithubTestResponse
GithubTestResponse.description: Rate-limit probe result (success carries quota, failure carries a message).

GrowthHistoryItem.title: GrowthHistoryItem
GrowthHistoryItem.description: One per-session growth snapshot (writers persist validated ``list[str]``).

GrowthProbeItem.title: GrowthProbeItem
GrowthProbeItem.description: One recent weak-point probe (entries come from a local JSON file).

ModelOptionsResponse.title: ModelOptionsResponse
ModelOptionsResponse.description: Flat model list for the scene selector (enabled entries only).

ModelProfileResponse.title: ModelProfileResponse
ModelProfileResponse.description: External view of one model entry (``profile_to_response``; no secret keys).

PrepLinkResponse.title: PrepLinkResponse
PrepLinkResponse.description: PUT /sessions/{id}/link: the session's linked target (null = unlinked).

PrepTruncateResponse.title: PrepTruncateResponse
PrepTruncateResponse.description: POST /sessions/{id}/messages/truncate: history length after the cut.

ProviderChannelResponse.title: ProviderChannelResponse
ProviderChannelResponse.description: External channel view (``channel_to_response``; key masked to a boolean).

RecommendedVendorResponse.title: RecommendedVendorResponse
RecommendedVendorResponse.description: Level 1 of the recommended-vendor cascade (capabilities keyed by model type).

SettingsDeleteResponse.title: SettingsDeleteResponse
SettingsDeleteResponse.description: Delete result for providers and model entries.

SystemGrowthInsights.title: SystemGrowthInsights
SystemGrowthInsights.description:
Cross-interview system aggregates plus environment flags for the growth page.

``extra="allow"``: the read path is fail-open and serves whatever snapshot
survived normalization, so unknown keys pass through instead of failing.

VendorCapabilityDef.title: VendorCapabilityDef
VendorCapabilityDef.description: Deep request template metadata from the vendor descriptor JSON.
